Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. What Success Looks Like Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Required What You Bring (Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants. Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations. Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products. Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs. Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams. Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions. Title: Data Analyst
Description: Position Summary We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Analyst to join our growing automotive operations team. In this role, you will help transform raw data into actionable insights that drive efficiency across our manufacturing, supply chain, and quality control processes. You will support senior analysts and engineering teams by maintaining databases, generating daily performance reports, and building interactive dashboards. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, a passion for the automotive sector, and a desire to grow their skills in data visualization and database management. Ad-Hoc Analysis: Support engineering, quality, and logistics teams with ad-hoc data requests to help identify the root causes of production bottlenecks or quality issues. Foundational knowledge of SQL for database querying and manipulation. Introductory experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). Basic understanding of programming languages like Python or R for data analysis. Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish. Preferred Qualifications Previous internship or project experience within the automotive manufacturing, supply chain, or mobility sector. Familiarity with automotive industry standards (e.g., IATF 16949) or lean manufacturing principles (Six Sigma, 5S). Knowledge of cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. Title: Data Engineer - Music DISCO, Music DISCO
Description: Description Amazon Music is awash in data! To help make sense of it all, the DISCO (Data, Insights, Science & Optimization) team: (i) enables the Consumer Product Tech org make data driven decisions that improve the customer retention, engagement and experience on Amazon Music. We build and maintain automated self-service data solutions, data science models and deep dive difficult questions that provide actionable insights. We also enable measurement, personalization and experimentation by operating key data programs ranging from attribution pipelines, northstar weblabs metrics to causal frameworks. (ii) delivering exceptional Analytics & Science infrastructure for DISCO teams, fostering a data-driven approach to insights and decision making. As platform builders, we are committed to constructing flexible, reliable, and scalable solutions to empower our customers. (iii) accelerates and facilitates content analytics and provides independence to generate valuable insights in a fast, agile, and accurate way. This domain provides analytical support for the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions while launching new features and evaluating existing features with the end goal of improving the customer experience. DISCO team enables repeatable, easy, in depth analysis of music customer behaviors. We reduce the cost in time and effort of analysis, data set building, model building, and user segmentation. Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools. If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services. We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. Duties include big data design and analysis, data modeling, and development, deployment, and operations of big data pipelines. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university. DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. Your team will manage the data exchange store (Data Lake) and EMR/Spark processing layer using Airflow as orchestrator. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines. Key job responsibilities You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization. A day in the life Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK). Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity. Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data. Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency. Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users. Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks. Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information. Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects. Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability. About The Team Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of data engineering experience Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Customer Master Data Analyst
Description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For As a Master Data Coordinator II, you will be the guardian of our customer data accuracy, directly impacting our enterprise operations, compliance, and customer experience. You will govern customer master data across our core systems, solve complex data issues, and ensure our order-to-cash processes run smoothly. This role is for you if you treat clean data as a critical deliverable and thrive on ensuring operational excellence in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities Create, update, validate, block/unblock, and deactivate customer master data records in source and MDM systems (e.g., Oracle EBS, Salesforce, SAP, or equivalent ERP/CRM/MDM platforms) in line with defined data standards and SLAs. Process master data service requests and tickets accurately and within agreed turnaround times; triage, prioritize, and escalate complex or non-standard cases as needed. Perform routine and ad-hoc data quality checks, identify anomalies, and execute remediation (deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and hierarchy maintenance). Investigate and resolve duplicate records; apply merge and survivorship decisions according to governance rules. Validate customer data against external reference sources (tax/VAT IDs, DUNS, sanctions/denied-party screening, address validation) and internal policies. Support compliance and control activities, including SOX-relevant controls, audit evidence requests, and segregation-of-duties requirements. Maintain and update master data documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Collaborate cross-functionally to resolve data issues, support customer onboarding, and unblock downstream order-to-cash processes. Contribute to data governance initiatives, system enhancements, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for MDM/ERP/CRM changes. Generate and review data quality reports and dashboards; track and report on KPIs and SLA performance. Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Coordinator I / junior team members, including peer review of their work where required. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field — or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of experience in master data management, data administration, data governance, or a related data operations role. Hands-on experience with at least one ERP, CRM, or MDM platform (e.g., Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, Informatica/Reltio MDM). Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables, basic data manipulation). Strong written and verbal communication in English. Ability to independently manage a queue of requests and prioritize against SLAs. Preferred Qualifications Experience specifically with customer master data, including hierarchies, deduplication, and merge/survivorship processes. Familiarity with data quality and reporting tools (Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or similar). Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOX) and audit support. Exposure to M&A data integration, system migrations, or large-scale data remediation projects. Additional language skills relevant to the region(s) supported. Core Competencies Data quality & accuracy mindset — treats clean data as the deliverable, not an afterthought. Analytical problem-solving — investigates root causes rather than just clearing tickets. Process & control orientation — follows governance rules and respects segregation of duties. Stakeholder collaboration — communicates clearly across business and technical teams. Ownership & time management — manages a workload independently and meets commitments. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Job Posting Statement To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. AI Technology Statement Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. Description: About This Role Your team The Accounting Data Management team is part of Aladdin Data and serves as a critical partner to BlackRock’s Investment Accounting and outsourced accounting business. The team manages the integrity, governance, and operational management of security, transaction, market, and accounting data used across investment accounting, regulatory reporting, portfolio operations, and client servicing. The team oversees the onboarding, validation, and maintenance of investment and accounting data while advancing automation, standardization, and scalable operating models. Through close partnership with accounting teams, portfolio operations, technology teams, data providers, and external investment managers, the team enables timely, accurate, and controlled data flows that support client reporting, regulatory obligations, and operational excellence. Your role and impact As the Accounting Data Lead, you will lead and develop a team supporting critical investment accounting data processes in Mexico. You will be responsible for strengthening data quality, operational controls, automation, and continuous improvement while helping the team deliver consistent and scalable outcomes. This role combines investment accounting knowledge, data management expertise, and people leadership. You will partner with global teams to improve processes, resolve complex data issues, enhance client outcomes, and advance BlackRock’s broader data strategy. Your Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Lead, develop, and mentor a team of data professionals, managing capacity, priorities, performance, and development while fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, inclusion, and operational excellence. Oversee the setup, maintenance, validation, and governance of security, transaction, market, and accounting data, ensuring its integrity, completeness, and accuracy across asset classes and data sources. Provide operational oversight of data pipelines, automated processes, exception management, and reconciliations, strengthening controls and issue-management practices to reduce operational risk. Partner with technology teams to improve data architecture, workflows, and straight-through-processing capabilities while identifying opportunities to automate, standardize, and simplify operational processes. Partner across Investment Accounting, Operations, Technology, Product, and Client Service to address complex data inquiries, identify root causes, and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholder groups. Support client onboarding, data migrations, and new implementations while building effective relationships with investment managers, custodians, market-data vendors, and other service providers. Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives focused on scalability, data quality, operating-model transformation, and platform modernization, using metrics and operational insights to improve efficiency, capacity planning, and service delivery. Your Experience Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Technology, Data Management, or a related field, with strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication capabilities. Eight or more years of relevant experience in investment operations, investment accounting, data management, or financial services, including experience leading teams or complex operational processes. Strong understanding of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative investments, with experience using accounting platforms, portfolio-management systems, or investment-operations workflows. Knowledge of investment accounting, fund accounting, regulatory reporting, or outsourced accounting operations, together with familiarity with data governance, data quality, risk management, and operational-control frameworks. Experience with Aladdin or comparable investment-management platforms, plus working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data analysis, automation, data-engineering concepts, and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity and change, influence stakeholders across functions and levels, and take ownership of high-quality outcomes. Experience leading process automation or operational-transformation initiatives, supported by a continuous-improvement mindset and a commitment to scalable solutions, innovation, collaboration, and client-service excellence. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.
